repository_head_relation_meaning: The R6 code-bearing commit sits ON TOP of the evidence commit this record names, so the exact-SHA run recorded here MEASURES THE EVIDENCE COMMIT AND NOT THIS HEAD. That is the honest state of a commit whose own run has not happened yet: a run cannot exist for a commit before the commit does. R6 §5 permits one documentation-only closeout, and naming this head together with its own exact-SHA run is exactly what that closeout is for. Until then no document may say the recorded run measures this head — that claim is what R5 was rejected for and what this gate exists to refuse.
